business_problem: igot.ai needed a governed AI operating model for audit and enterprise workflows, where teams could search and reason over complex document repositories without maintaining heavy custom infrastructure.
solution_summary: igot.ai uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: igot.ai needed a governed AI operating model for audit and enterprise workflows, where teams could search and reason over complex document repositories without maintaining heavy custom infrastructure. BigQuery grounds analysis in enterprise data and gives the platform a scalable foundation for document and workflow context, serving as the storage layer. Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform provides the managed environment where the platform builds and deploys AI capabilities with governance, serving as the serving layer. Gemini Pro reasons over documents and generates structured outputs for specialized workflow agents, serving as the compute layer. Google Kubernetes Engine runs and scales the multi-agent workflows that coordinate retrieval, analysis, validation, and execution, serving as the orchestration layer.
